test_family: maximum same-signature entity support across all metrics, candidate types, directions, years, and split-support classes

inference_limits.exchangeability_assumption: Candidate calendar timing is exchangeable only conditional on candidate existence and the admissible year support. Nonstationary source revisions, coverage shifts, or time-varying candidate detectability can violate this assumption.
inference_limits.interpretation: Diagnostic test of cross-entity calendar coincidence; not a detector FPR/FDR or a source-independent validation.
